page.overview:
Who is Evodon Leeds?

is an older human working as one of the Keepers of the Light above Sanctum in Uthodurn. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Evodon has short gray hair, dark skin, and a trimmed beard. His eyes and smile are kind. When Deanna Leimert met with him just after the Apogee Solstice, he seemed nervous and concerned, and was shooing worshippers away.

Although others were not being permitted within the temple following the disruption to magic caused by the solstice, Elder Leeds greeted Deanna familiarly, and referred to her being "the bearer of the miracle" of some of the great deities, presumably referring to her resurrected status. He confessed that his connection with the Dawnfather, in some respects, had been severed, but that he was now convinced the temple should remain open. Deanna gave him 500 gold and noticed as she left he was urging the people waiting outside to enter.
